summary: CR-073 Recipe Bulk Editor — full frontend QA on live preprod (kunafamahal tenant, 92 standard recipes). 12 of 14 review items PASS (V1-V8, V10-V13). CRITICAL: V9 Batch Save fails with 422 'The name field is required'; RT-1 Round-Trip persistence therefore FAILS. Root cause: RecipeBulkEditor does not reverse-lookup foodId from foodName like RecipeFormPanel does (BUG-197 #7 workaround), so `name: null` is sent for every existing standard recipe update. Card-view save on the same endpoint returns 200 — the endpoint itself is healthy.

critical.issue: Backend returns 422 'The name field is required' when Bulk Editor sends name: null. Not a backend bug — backend correctly rejects invalid payload. Card view PUT to the same endpoint with name: <food_id> returns 200. Included here for context, not as a backend defect.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing foodId reverse-lookup from foodName. When editing existing standard recipes, `normaliseRecipe()` sets `foodId: r.foodId ?? null`, but the GET recipe list endpoint does NOT return food_id (per BUG-197 #7 note in RecipeFormPanel.jsx L50). Result: every existing standard recipe update PUT ships `{name: null, ...}`, backend returns 422 'The name field is required'. The RecipeFormPanel does not have this bug because it explicitly matches food_name against foodsMaster (L50-53) to populate foodId before saving.

Same pattern likely fails for addon recipes: `addonId: r.addonId ?? null`. Backend addon list DOES return addon_id (confirmed by fromAPI.addonRecipes → addonId: r.addon_id || null), so may or may not repro. Not exercised in this test run because kunafamahal has 0 addon recipes.

integration_issues.flow: V9 Batch Save → RT-1 Round-Trip persistence
integration_issues.issue: Bulk save of existing standard recipe with prep=55 → PUT returns 422; results banner correctly shows '✗ 50-50 Choco Lava · The name field is required'. Recipe prep does NOT persist. After reload, prep reverts to original value. Card-view save of the same recipe with prep=88/prep=10 succeeds (200) — proving the endpoint works and the bug is Bulk-Editor-payload-only.

issues: Partial-success error banner (A3 UX) works correctly — clear red '✗ recipe-name · error-message' line surfaced. Good UX for surfacing this bug to users. No design regressions observed.

action_items: FIX RecipeBulkEditor.jsx: Port the BUG-197 #7 workaround from RecipeFormPanel.jsx L50-53 — reverse-lookup foodId (and addonId) from foodName/addonName against foodsMaster before building the save payload. Suggested locations: either enrich rows on hydrate `useEffect([recipes, recipeType, foodsMaster])` or resolve in `handleSave()` per row before dispatch.store/update. Add unit assertion: after hydrate, every existing standard/addon row has non-null foodId/addonId when a matching menu item exists.
Add validation in handleSave to fail-fast client-side when name/foodId is null so we surface a clearer error than server-side 422 (avoid confusing user).

Regression: verify addon-tab Bulk saves work (kunafamahal has 0 addon recipes so wasn't exercised here). Sub-recipe saves should also be smoke-tested since normaliseRecipe zeroes out foodId/addonId for sub as well (unused for sub, but worth confirming payload symmetry).

Consider: axios interceptor kicks user to /login on 401 during Bulk saves — a stale token during a long-lived Bulk-edit session would silently discard all pending edits. Not part of CR-073 but worth a UX warning.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L34-58 normaliseRecipe(): `foodId: r.foodId ?? null` accepts whatever the list endpoint returns. Since fromAPI.recipes() in recipeTransform.js already sets `foodId: r.food_id || null` and the get-recipe endpoint reportedly omits food_id (BUG-197 #7), foodId is null for all existing standard recipes. Downstream, toAPI.updateRecipe() maps `name: data.foodId` → sends name:null → 422. Same recipe list is used by RecipeFormPanel which reverse-looks-up foodId via foodsMaster; RecipeBulkEditor already loads foodsMaster (L82-88) but never uses it to enrich rows.

RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L190-200 handleSave payload: No client-side guard that foodId is non-null for existing standard recipes. The validation only checks `row.isNew && !row.foodId`. Consider extending: `if (recipeType==='standard' && !row.foodId) failed.push({error:'Menu food link missing'})`.
RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L60 total file size: 567 lines. Approaching the 700-line limit. Consider extracting RecipeRow subcomponent to its own file (already 165 lines just for that inner component).
RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L241 handleImportClick: no visible progress indicator during Excel import; user may double-click. Consider disable-while-uploading.
RecipeBulkEditor.jsx L156-169 deleteRow uses window.confirm — inconsistent with the rest of the app using shadcn AlertDialog. Minor UX inconsistency.

RecipeManagementPanel.jsx L200-205: When switching tab while in Bulk view, the same viewMode is preserved and RecipeBulkEditor keys off `activeTab` — good. But the dirty state in RecipeBulkEditor is cleared on `recipes/recipeType` change (L74-78) — meaning switching tabs silently discards unsaved edits. Consider a confirm-before-switch guard.

recipeTransform.js toAPI.updateRecipe L104-118: Maps `name: data.foodId`. This is fragile — the field name 'name' is misleading; if backend ever renames to food_id, both card and bulk break. Consider aliasing `name: (data.foodId ?? data.name)` as defense in depth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-073 core UI (12 tests) passes cleanly. The single defect is a payload bug: RecipeBulkEditor.jsx does not reverse-lookup foodId from foodName like RecipeFormPanel.jsx L50-53 does. As soon as main-agent adds the enrichment (either in normaliseRecipe using foodsMaster or in handleSave), V9 and RT-1 should pass. Test recipe used: '50-50 Choco Lava' (recipe_id 4874, food_id 168408) — good candidate for regression retest since it exists on preprod. Do not run repeated bulk saves without reverting — the A3 partial-success banner works but there's no undo. Card-view path on the same endpoint is confirmed healthy (verified 200 with payload {name:168408,...}).
rca of the issue: STEP 1 (repro): Login → /recipes → click Bulk → edit prep on any existing standard recipe (e.g. 50-50 Choco Lava) → click 'Save Changes (1)'. STEP 2 (network): Playwright request interception captured PUT /api/v2/vendoremployee/recipe/update-recipe/4874 with body `{"name":null,"recipe_qty":1,"recipe_unit":"plates","preparation_time":"55","serve_time":"2","serves_people":1,"ingredients":[...]}` → response 422 `The name field is required`. STEP 3 (compare): Same recipe saved via Card view (RecipeFormPanel → 'Update Recipe' button) sends `{"name":168408,"recipe_qty":1,...}` → 200 OK and persists. STEP 4 (RCA): Diff in code paths — RecipeFormPanel.jsx L50-53 has BUG-197 #7 workaround that matches recipe.foodName against foodsMaster to fill missing foodId before save. RecipeBulkEditor.jsx has no such workaround. Since fromAPI.recipes() sets `foodId: r.food_id || null` and the list endpoint omits food_id, `row.foodId` stays null. Then `toAPI.updateRecipe` maps `name: data.foodId` → null → 422. MITIGATION: In RecipeBulkEditor.jsx normaliseRecipe (or in a new post-hydrate useEffect using foodsMaster), do: `const food = foodsMaster.find(f => (f.name||f.food_name||'').trim().toLowerCase() === (r.foodName||r.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()); foodId: r.foodId || food?.id || null` — then re-run V9 & RT-1.
